selection.SSL: Complete saved validation losses, equally weighted subject groups, epoch0 included, strict minimum and earliest tie
selection.supervised: Original primary left_right validation subject balanced accuracy; no test-based selection

implementation: Call byte-identical phase2 benchmark_evaluate.py, benchmark_common.py, benchmark_idle.py, benchmark_audit.py and harness_mapping.py through separately hashed admission; the new runtime owns selected SSL lineage verification

harness.routing: Same pinned frozen SmolLM2 backbone, same16 greedy prompt templates, X/Y parser, max8 new tokens, no EEG prefix, no target/gold/subject/trial/time in prompt

limitations: Repeated evaluation on the same fixed held-out people is an exploratory comparison; previous results do not select new settings or checkpoints.
Subject bootstrap describes fixed-checkpoint cohort uncertainty, not retraining uncertainty; no multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claim.
Cued motor imagery and instructed T0 rest do not establish spontaneous intention, natural idle false actions per minute, or real OS task success.
Four synthetic mappings reuse each EEG record and are not four independent neural observations.
More optimizer presentations do not increase distinct EEG duration; exposure of the selected encoder path is separated from all completed training steps.
